results.name: A: page loads with no tasks
B: 3 task cards appear (task_ids newest first)
C: all 3 stream concurrently (text grows over 2 s)
D: all 3 run to completion (🔄, progress == max)
E: restart a completed task resets and streams again
I: after reload mid-stream the running bg tasks keep streaming into the tab
I2: streams started before the reload complete (progress == max)
J: 2nd tab has its own token and an empty task list
J2: 2nd tab streams its own task; tab 1 unaffected
K: duplicated-token tab gets a new_token and its own (empty) state
K2: tab 1 still works after the duplicate connected
K3: duplicated tab shows none of tab 1's tasks afterwards
console: no unexpected errors/warnings + no page errors
